model_annotation: This chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms across six medical specialty categories, comparing a base model (Mistralv0.2-Base) with versions fine-tuned on different specialty datasets. The horizontal axis is labeled "Per-specialty terms" and contains six categories: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately -27 to -22, with tick marks at integer intervals. Each category on the horizontal axis contains a group of seven bars representing different model variants, as indicated by the legend: Mistralv0.2-Base (light blue), and fine-tuned versions on Cardio (light peach/tan), Gastro (light orange), Infect (medium orange), Neuro (golden orange), Obstetrics (dark golden/amber), and Pediatrics (dark brown). The bars extend downward (toward more negative values), with all bars generally falling in the range of approximately -23 to -27. Across most specialty term categories, the Mistralv0.2-Base bar (light blue) tends to extend furthest downward (most negative values, around -27), while the fine-tuned variants show slightly less negative values (shorter bars). Notably, within each group, the bar corresponding to the fine-tuned model matching the specialty category appears to reach slightly higher (less negative) values than the other fine-tuned variants — for example, the Cardio fine-tuned bar appears slightly shorter in the Cardio category. The bars are not sorted by value but are consistently ordered within each group according to the legend sequence. No bars appear to be explicitly annotated with numerical values or visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
